metadata.model: Federal ground elevations resampled from a bounded COG overview to an approximately 500 m national grid. Display relief is exaggerated; surface draping is not surveyed rail, bridge, tunnel or cable height.

metadata.lakeModel: Flat DEM-derived lake levels; median interior grid-cell height, lower shoreline sample for sub-grid lakes. No live water-level observations.
